dedupe_keys.name: 臺北自來水事業統計年報 statistical yearbook of the taipei water department 2025 edition

description: The Taipei Water Department, which supplies Taipei City and parts of New Taipei, publishes an annual statistical yearbook of its operations, released on the city's open data platform. The dataset page read on 2026-09-28 offers the 2025 edition (ROC year 114) as a 17.91 MB PDF updated on 29 May 2026, prepared by the department's accounting office and described as providing the utility's important statistics to improve understanding of its operations; the page lists it as free, in Chinese, as a routine statistical yearbook with GPN 2005200014 and ISSN 1812-3104. Coverage is the Taipei Water Department supply area. Access is free download, but the rights statement says the department holds the copyright and text and figures may not be reproduced without consent. Caveats: tables are in a PDF, so values must be transcribed, and the table list was not opened. It supports capacity planning and resilience studies of a large Asian water utility, such as production, network length and losses over time. No related Taiwanese water utility record is catalogued.
